main_text.p: tibus conclavis valvis, sententiam tulêre. Quæ ut intelligi possit, quæ partium postulata fuerint, aperiendum. Agrarii or-Postulata partis u-triusque.dines secuti vestigia consiliorum priorum de solvendo fœdere, divortium postulaverunt, separationem integram per quam sibi consulerent seorsim, suamque tenerent remp. divisam à civitate, nec quicquam cum hac haberent commune, præter viciniam & commercia libera. Speciatim verò Hovetmannorum à senatu oppidano datorum jurisdictionem recusabant omninò, conventus habere suos, quando & ubi commodum sibi, seclusa civitate, in iis de rep. consultare & statuere, collegium provinciale suum tenere, judices summos exse [?] edere volebant: jus fori rerum venalium in oppido, & id quod de frumento & cerevisia dixi, ex fœderibus promanans, in universum rescissum cupiebant. Minora mittoCivitas contra, conjunctionem solitam summa ratione institutam olim, longissimoque tempore probatam, transactionibus & decretis multis roboratam, poscebat: Hovetmannorum electionem & potestatem ex more prisco, & quæ.

page.notes: Printed text is one unbroken paragraph running over from the previous page; no indent on any line. "exse" is uncertain, marked [?]. "mittoCivitas" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. "con" / "junctionem" is joined across the line end without a printed hyphen, so written whole. The catchword "& quæ." is printed at the lower right. The running head has no number beside it. The faint watermark at the bottom right is not transcribed.
